summary: The survivors open Grisha's basement. What they find is not a weapon. It is a record that the walls were never the edge of the world.

segments.ja: シガンシナの戦闘が終わり、街は瓦礫の静けさになります。静けさの中に、生存者は少ないです。少ない列が、エレンの家へ向かいます。向かう理由は、もう敵の配置が崩れた、です。崩れたあとで、ようやく扉の順番が来ます。来る順番を、エレンは首の鍵で待っていました。待っていた鍵が、今日、初めて実用になります。実用は、祝う音ではありません。
segments.en: The fight in Shiganshina ends, and the town becomes the quiet of rubble. Among the quiet, the survivors are few. The few in the line head toward Eren's house. The reason they head there is that the enemy's arrangement has already collapsed. After it collapsed, the turn of the door finally comes. Eren had been waiting for the turn that comes with the key at his neck. The key he had been waiting for becomes practical today for the first time. The practical use is not a sound of celebration.

segments.en: Eren's house remains, off from the heat of the fight. The room that remains is narrower than a child's memory. Carla's absence is still in the narrow room. Mikasa does not make the absence that is there into words. Without making it, they search for the position of the stairs. Under the stairs they search is the basement. The basement is the opposite of the place his father said not to go. Today the order of the investigation points toward the opposite place. Pointing is the lifting of a child's prohibition.

segments.ja: エレンは、グリシャの鍵を地下室の錠に合わせます。合わせる金属が、初めて抵抗なく回ります。回る音は、小さいです。小さい音のあと、扉が開きます。開く扉の向こうは、宝物の光ではありません。光ではなく、机と、紙と、暗い棚です。棚を、ハンジが先に検分します。検分する手は、武器を探す手です。探す武器は、そこには見当たりません。見当たらないことが、最初の驚きです。
segments.en: Eren fits Grisha's key to the basement's lock. The metal he fits turns for the first time without resistance. The sound of turning is small. After the small sound, the door opens. Beyond the door that opens is not the light of treasure. It is not light. It is a desk, paper, and a dark shelf. Hange inspects the shelf first. The hand that inspects is a hand looking for a weapon. The weapon it looks for is not found there. Not being found is the first surprise.

segments.en: The center of the basement is a book. The book is not a scroll that writes a Titan's weakness in one blow. It is not. In his father's hand, the world outside the walls is recorded. Eren cannot read at once every page that was recorded. The reason he cannot read it is that the amount is large, and the premise differs from the walls' education. Hange picks up the different premise. The words she picks up are: there is a human country outside the walls. The one sentence that there is is heavier than a weapon.

segments.en: The education inside the walls taught the outside of the walls as an empty hell. The book says that beyond the hell it taught, there is a human society. Armin lays the content it says over the hypothesis of the sea. The sea he lays over it is still a picture. Beyond the picture are a country, a history, and his father's origin. This episode of the basement does not unfold the whole origin. The reason it does not unfold it is that the pages are material for the next episode. With only the first sentence of the material, the edge of the world moves. The edge that moves is the real result of the retaking.

segments.titleJa: エレンは父の字を見る
segments.titleEn: Eren looks at his father's hand
segments.ja: エレンは、グリシャの字を指で追います。追う字は、診療の父の字と同じです。同じ字が、壁の外の人間のことを書いています。書いている父は、壁の中の医者だけではなかった、ということです。ということの重さを、彼はすぐに怒りにはしません。しないまま、鍵の役目が終わります。終わる鍵を、彼はまだ首から外しません。外さないことが、父の続きを自分の体で持つ癖です。癖は、今日、本という形を見ます。
segments.en: Eren follows Grisha's handwriting with a finger. The handwriting he follows is the same as the handwriting of the father of the clinic. The same handwriting is writing about humans outside the walls. It means the father who was writing was not only a doctor inside the walls. He does not at once make the weight of that meaning into anger. Without making it, the key's role ends. He still does not take from his neck the key that ends. Not taking it off is the habit of holding his father's continuation in his own body. The habit sees today a shape called a book.

segments.titleJa: アルミンは海を確認する
segments.ja: アルミンは、本の中に海に近い記述を探します。探す目は、白夜のあとでも研究者の目です。目が見つけるのは、壁の外に広い水と、人間の文明がある、という方向です。方向は、彼が子供のときに本で見た絵と一致します。一致することが、囮になった意味の一部を返します。返す意味は、完全ではありません。完全でなくても、焼けた体で買った未来が、絵ではなく記録になります。記録が、彼の生存の最初の報酬です。
segments.en: Armin searches in the book for a description close to the sea. The eyes that search are a researcher's eyes even after the midnight sun. What the eyes find is a direction: outside the walls there is wide water and a human civilization. The direction matches the picture he saw in a book as a child. Matching returns part of the meaning of having become the decoy. The meaning it returns is not complete. Even not complete, the future bought with a burned body becomes a record, not a picture. The record is the first reward of his survival.

segments.ja: ハンジは、本を個人の形見にはしません。しない判断は、これが兵団と女王の資料だ、です。資料を、彼女は壊れないように包みます。包む手は、興奮しています。興奮の下で、手順は正確です。正確な手順が、頁をシガンシナの埃から離します。離した頁を、壁の内側へ持ち帰る計画が立ちます。立つ計画は、読む続きを急がない、ではありません。急ぐ、です。急ぐ理由は、無知がもう一日を許さない、です。
segments.en: Hange does not make the book into a personal keepsake. The judgment of not making it is that this is material for the corps and the queen. She wraps the material so it will not break. The hand that wraps it is excited. Under the excitement, the procedure is exact. The exact procedure separates the pages from Shiganshina's dust. A plan stands to carry the separated pages back inside the walls. The plan that stands is not a refusal to hurry the rest of the reading. It is to hurry. The reason to hurry is that ignorance does not allow another day.

segments.ja: ミカサは、本の内容より先に、家の埃を見ます。見る埃は、カルラが掃除していた床の続きです。続きの床に、三人はもう子供では立てません。立てない体で、彼女はエレンの肩の位置を確認します。確認は、鍵が回ったあとも、隣にいる、です。いることが、地下室の感情の側です。側は、世界の端が動いても変わりません。変わらない隣が、この家の最後の家具です。
segments.en: Ahead of the book's content, Mikasa looks at the dust of the house. The dust she looks at is the continuation of the floor Carla used to clean. On the floor of the continuation, the three can no longer stand as children. With a body that cannot stand as a child, she checks the position of Eren's shoulder. The check is: even after the key turned, I am beside you. Being there is the feeling side of the basement. The side does not change even if the edge of the world moves. The unchanging beside is the last piece of furniture in this house.
